notes.title: 1.3.1 Update, with OverKill, new zombie, and more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.kinja-img.com/gawker-media/image/upload/s--t2T_6EQC--/198qj0pvzn5wqgif.gif[/img]

[h1]Finally! What's new?[/h1]
Well.. Here we go:

[h1]OverKill[/h1]
[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/12983813_955177691267823_929751644293864060_o.png[/img]
-Probably the biggest update in a loong time! OverKill system is something that lets the most hardcore players continue their joyrney with even more awesome, and new stuff even after hours of playing! With OverKill, everything you do, is [b]OverKill![/b]
Let me explain briefly.
Once player levels up to LVL41, she/he will be given a option, to reset their leveling progress for an exhange of OverKill perk. There are a few OK perks in this update, but more will come some time in the future! One of these perks, is this little thing, that allows you to choose two perks, instead of one! 
PS. If you're level 80 or over, don't worry! OverKill resetting will only take away 40 levels from your progress! Which means, that if you're a LVL80 (for example) you can select TWO OverKill perks in total!

[h1]New zombie![/h1]
[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/13055950_958657654253160_785686927021501743_o.png[/img]
-This one is a high roller. If you see one of these. Run. You may have a chance of getting away.

[h1]New clothing![/h1]
[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/12984061_956919111093681_763201802068352433_o.png[/img]
-A weird scientist and his sidekick are here to kick some zombie butt!

[h1]Bugs fixed![/h1]
-Mister "Nope, not coming" -Tank has changed his mood, and will make an appearance from now on when he's supposed to!
-Other silly bugs fixed
-Some silly bugs added? Who knows?

[h1]So, what took you so long, eh?[/h1]
-Well, that is a good question. I don't really know the answer even myself.. I've really lost the motivation for making games a few months back, and I'm still trying to get it back. It's really frustrating, as I would have tons and tons of cool ideas for ZKW, and for other games, but I just don't have the motivation to do anything about it.. Really sucks. But don't worry. I'm not ditching ZKW. Nope. I'm just making progress slowly. I hope you understand this, and just give me some time.


Ok, that's that! Go slay some zombieeeess!

notes.title: Massive update on it's way!
notes.notes:
[img]https://img.buzzfeed.com/buzzfeed-static/static/2014-08/29/16/enhanced/webdr10/anigif_enhanced-9754-1409344312-11.gif[/img]

[h1]So, you still care, eh?[/h1]
Ofcourse I care! Don't even ask something like that. Geez.
Anyways, as you know, it's been a long time since the previous "proper" update, and now I'm here to fix that.

[h1]I thought you were too lazy for that?[/h1]
True.. True.. Well, not really.
I just lost my motivation entirely for some reason. But now I'm getting it back! If everything goes well, you will be getting a new, proper, update for ZKW next weeks Friday! (22.4.2016)

[h1]So, what's in this, "proper", update then?[/h1]
Actually, I'm not yet sure about it all. I have so many ideas I want to make. But! One thing is for sure atleast.
You will be getting fancy..ed new player-menu (well, I just made it more fancy, that's all) and..

[h1]OverKill[/h1]
[img]http://files.1337upload.net/firepower-a081c8.png[/img]
Overkill is something that's really made for veteran ZKW players. Once you level up to Level 40, you will be given a option to reset your profile (well, only your level, really) and by doing so, you can select one of these OverKill "Perks". Currently, there are 6 of them, but I might be adding even more. I'm not going into details of what these special perks are just yet, but let me tell you.. They can change the gameplay very dramatically.
Also note, that it's not a must for someone to reset their profile. You can play to level 100 if you like. But if you do, you will actually be able to choose 2 OverKill perks! Let me explain.
When a player chooses to reset their profile for an OverKill perk at Level50, their profile will be resetted only to Level10. So, choosing an OverKill perk makes you go back 40 levels. Which means, that all those veteran players with Level80, or more, havent actually done it all for nothing!
I'll also note you, that it is possible to achieve every OverKill perk there is, as they are infinite. Once obtained, it will stay on forever (unless you choose to start a whole new game, that is) There still are couple OverKill perks, that only work once, and you can't select them anymore after it's been used.

I really hope this makes any sense to you, but if not, don't worry. You'll see what's up next week!

Keep slaying, and I keep developing!

notes.title: Surprise update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://media2.onsugar.com/files/2013/11/07/831/n/1922398/9d62fd4fa48c4072_25.gif[/img]

[h1]What's up?[/h1]
[b]-New resolution![/b] (Glorious 720p!..)
[b]-Steam overlay fixed for Mac[/b] 
[b]-Workshop is now fixed
-Ingame memory leak fixed[/b] (this is what caused ZKW to lagg on some computers)
[b]-Upgraded rifle's missing arm was found[/b]
[b]-Tons of small bugs fixed. You can trust me. I'm on internet.[/b]
[b]-New encouragement dying text's.[/b]

[h1]Wait.. 720? Why not 1080p bruh?[/h1]
-I'm sorry it took so long for me to realize how important part of gaming the game's resolution is. Old resolution was very odd, 480x320. I have no idea where I've taken those numbers.. But now, I've increased the resolution to glorious.. Ehm.. 720p. I wanted to use 1080p, but that broke the game entirely, so I couldn't do that.. *sadface*
If you're having any problems with the new resolution (or something seems to be a bit off..) please, let me know on the Bug-reports topic about it!

[h1]Great. Now it lags on my iPotato[/h1]
-Due to the increased resolution of the game, I noticed some heavy lagging on my MacBook Air 2011. This was fixed with switching the game to be on full-screen, instead of windowed. I'll look into this issue next. Also, turning off v-sync should improve performance as well.

[h1]And not even a new map!? What took you so long!?[/h1]
-Believe me or not, I actually have this something called [i]life[/i]. If you have watched my videos, you already know a little what's going on. One thing that's also taking my time nowadays, is a new project. Yes, I'm working on something else than ZKW (for the first time in almost 6 years!) and I'm having a blast with it :)
That said, I'm not going to stop supporting ZKW-Reborn. No. But please, don't expect me to start making weekly updates for ZKW again, because I can't do that. I will be fixing bugs whenever those are found, and maybe even add new levels, and zombies, and weapons at some point. But right now I have other plans. Who knows.. Maybe a new ZKW after [i]Sweet Dreams[/i] is done..?

notes.title: 1.3.03 Update is here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://45.media.tumblr.com/8a1e01c6382e47d84af3f897fb6187cb/tumblr_nrec4rBtTB1uq0g6io8_400.gif[/img]

[h1]What's new this time?[/h1]
Nothing much. But!
This update makes all platforms ready for the iOS version, that is coming next Monday (21.12.2015) so we all better be ready for that!

[h1]List. Because people love list of things. And I love listing.[/h1]

-[b]Gamepad support should be improved
-Small bugs here and there have been fixed
-This update makes it possible for me to make a major update for the multiplayer servers
-Multiplayer has been optimized more[/b] (there shouldn't be people flying all over the places anymore.. Shouldn't. That's the key word here)
-[b]1,2,3 keys can now be binded[/b] for another use!
-[b]You can now re-bind your weapon-selection keys![/b]


[h1]Avast users!! Important!![/h1]
If you're using Avast as your anti-virus software, [b]make sure you have updated that to the latest version available![/b]
I noticed that if you are running on a older version of Avast, it can cause the game to freeze on the start, and do funky things. So please, update your Avast before playing!

[h1]Known bugs with this version[/h1]
There are a few.. unfortunately.
-Gamepad support is not working for MacOSX at this point. I'm sorry about this. But don't worry. This will get fixed as soon as possible!

-Steam overlay isn't working on MacOSX. Right now, there's actually nothing I can do to fix this. There seems to be a some kind of a bug in the game creation software I'm using, but I've been talking to the developers of the software, and they are fixing this bug. So don't worry!

[h1]iOS![/h1]
Yes! iOS version will be released next Monday! Stay tuned! And remember to follow Still Running's [url=https://www.facebook.com/StillrunningGame] Facebook [/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/StillRunningZKW] Twitter [/url] so you won't miss anything!

Happy holidays folks!

notes.title: Yet another hot-patch for 1.3!
notes.notes:
[img]http://25.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_m3rtyerfHZ1qir45xo1_500.gif[/img]

[i]The second night was over.. In the morning, I was expecting to wake up yet in another terror.. Yes. There was terror. But notably less, than the night before.. So I took a deep breath, opened Steam, Facebook, Twitter, e-mail, youtube, and Google Play, to read about the horrible things that took place during the night. I was pleased to notice that things were getting better. But there was still work to be done...
[TO BE CONTINUED]
[/i]
(Maybe I should just stick with making games, eh?)

[h1]Full list of things that were fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Famas, and upgraded pistol is now working properly!
[*]Random and annoying crashes during online multiplayer about the bullets has now been fixed!
[*]Weapons shooting/reloading speeds should now be fixed for good!
[*]Katana's swinging speed fixed!
[*]Shooting with grenade launcher resulted in an fatal error. Fixed!
[*]Throwing a grenade on mobile made the guns non-workin, not anymore!
[*]Elevators randomly decide they don't want to work as elevators anymore. I've talked to them, and they have accepted their job as elevators!
[*]Game accusing players for hacking has been fixed!
[*]Upgraded weapons loosing their upgrades after trying to reload a full clip, fixed!
[*]Throwing grenades with gamepads have been fixed!
[/list]

Here. Apologies that I it took some time to get the 1.3 in a stable state, but I hope it is stable now!

Keep the zombies headless! They actually like it that way!

notes.title: Version 1.3 coming up!
notes.notes:
[h1]HomeRun[/h1]

As many of you guys already know, things haven't gone too well for me in the last month. Which is also why there hasn't been an single update for ZKW-Reborn for a loooooooooooooong time.

Even tho there has been a good reason why you haven't gotten your updates, I still can't stop feeling like I've let the players down. I just feel like the events that have stopped me from making these updates, are simply not enough to justify the fact that you have been just sitting there (like zombies), waiting for the new update to some day roll in.

[h1]New map![/h1]

-Yes! Finally! There will be a new map, called [b]HomeRun[/b] in the next update! This has been so far the most challenging map to make, because of.. Stuff.. That I cannot yet tell you. [h1]Delta time![/h1]
-Now even the most potato-computer owners can enjoy the game!

[h1]OverKill system![/h1]

[i]Yes, I am aware that the OverKill menu looks like.. Well, bad. But that's because it's all placeholder. Anyways, some of you, who have been around for long enough, may remember the "OverKill" feature from the original ZKW back in 2010?
So, what is "OverKill" ?
Basically, it's a feature, that you can unlock when you level up to LVL40. By "OverKilling" your character, you basically reset your profile, almost complitely. But every time you do this, you can select one "OverKill" item to bring in to the new life with you.
Here's a few examples of these OverKill items:
-OverKill machine (Advanced fridge. You get to open this magical thing once in every game, for free. And it can give you pretty much any weapon in the game, based on your OverKill level. Even the upgraded ones)
-Weapon customization cap increase
-Stacking perks
And more.. [/i]

Moving on!

[h1]Updated menu![/h1]

[h1]New, improved, skill-tree![/h1]
[img]https://scontent-ams2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtf1/v/t1.0-9/11947664_829156987203228_2498729622040511890_n.png?oh=182da4579af62e340f4f997e84e1ce3c&oe=5688C85A[/img]

[h1]Gawd.. How long is this going to taaaake!?[/h1]
[img]http://media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lgbith0wC61qf8yek.gif[/img]
-I know most of you are already starting to look like this (and the rest of you have stopped reading already) but hang on! There's more!

[h1]New voice acting![/h1]
-Now, I couldn't get a picture of the sound.. So.. Anyways. Yes, we have a new voice actor for ZKW-Reborn!

[h1]Improved gamepad support![/h1]
[img]http://stillrunning.fi/ZKW_ingame/gifuli.gif[/img]
-Isn't that just much more clear than the old one :) Ofcourse, there has been more gamepad optimization within the game than just this!

[h1]New difficulty modes![/h1]
-You thought "normal" was challenging? Pft..

[h1]Overall ingame improvements![/h1]
-Improved ingame physics, improved effects, improved stability, improved this, and improved that.. Much improvement, such update!

[h1]Mac and iOS![/h1]
[img]https://scontent-ams2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfa1/v/t1.0-9/11813299_816345228484404_5437372224084363874_n.jpg?oh=50aa7f5bf5684ebe63377fbb7039515e&oe=5698AC11[/img]
[img]https://scontent-ams2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtp1/v/t1.0-9/11248079_780469625405298_3671483550317375079_n.jpg?oh=151b16f7568458815df6c51dc0da13a4&oe=56936262[/img]
-If everything goes as planned, the 1.3 version will land on Mac and iOS as well!

[h1]That's it? Please?[/h1]
-Yeah, I think that's enough for you to handle right now. In case some of you actually managed to get into this point, good! Give yourself a hug!

[h1]When can we haz the update?[/h1]
-There are still a ton of stuff to be done, but I would say this month.
[i]Can I haz a day?[/i]
-Sure. 31.10. Happy?


Ok, so that's all for now!
Remember to take a shower every now and then. You wouldn't want to be shot because someone thought you were a zombie, now wouldn't you?

notes.title: (almost) Fresh Patch Friday #2 (1.2.32)
notes.notes:
Ok so, I was at a vacation for the first time last week, which meant that I didn't have time to make a new patch for you guys. Anyhow, I've got one for you now!

[h1]LAN multiplayer works again![/h1]
-Now you are all like "huh? When it didn't work?"
Well, it didn't. I actually had to re-write the whole connecting/hosting process for the LAN multiplayer, but it's working now again :)

[h1]Small adjustments![/h1]
-I've fixed the buggy camera on the game now, and it should be smoother, and well.. Shouldn't make you seasick anymore!

[h1]GORE[/h1]
[i]Shouldn't this be in "small adjustments?" No. This deserves it's own section[/i]
-The PC version now has more gore! Yes! Go paint those walls red!

[h1]Protection![/h1]
-Always remember protection! Now, if you connect to someones game after it's already started, you will get a free shield that is activated when your game starts! This way you won't be such an easy target, pewpewing with your silly pistol on round 18.

[h1]Bugs. Less of those[/h1]
-I have also fixed some fatal errors some players have been occuring, and hopefully stopped the players from teleporting as much.

Sorry for not having anything else, but I only had a few hours to make the update!
Now I'll get some server issues fixed (they are actually FLOODING!) so don't be surprised if you suddenly get disconnected from your multiplayer match. It's just me, playing with the servers :)

Now. Paint. Those. Walls. [b]red[/b]

notes.title: Fresh Patch Friday #1! (1.2.3)
notes.notes:
Heyho! What's new this time?

[h1]Joining games that have already started![/h1]
-Oh yes! It is now possible to join a game that has been started already! No more waiting on the lobby!
-You can also start a multiplayer match by yourself, and wait for others to come to play while you are already slaughtering zombies!
[i]-This is limited to Round 20 Players can't join your game after Round 20 has passed.[/i]

[h1]New upgrade powerups![/h1]
-I noticed you were enjoying the flaming bullets, bouncing bullets, and other upgrade powerups. So I added more! One of those is called "splitting bullets" (the name might be a bit too revealing..?) 

[h1]New weapon upgrades![/h1]
-RPG's rockets now set everything in flames when they explode!
-D.8.M. now has 15 bullets (shells..?  Plasma shots..?) instead of 3!

[h1]Optimized online multiplayer![/h1]
-Less data sent equals more happy players :)

[h1]Bugs fixed[/h1]
-It's been five years already. But they just keep coming. And I keep crushing them.

That's all for now folks!
Have a blast with those zombies! Don't get too touchy with the undead! You don't want to get any worse than you already are!

notes.title: New Patch Friday 1.2.25!
notes.notes:
[i]But, 1.2.24 comes after 1.2.23? Right?[/i]
Well, yes. But I just felt like skipping a number this time. Because I can.

[h1]Multiplayer optimization![/h1]
And a ton of that! I have started implementing a new system within the game, that can split the sent data in half. This is still on experimental stage, so if weird stuff starts to happen (dying awkwardly to the pink zombies is not a bug) please report them to [b]bug reports[/b] on the community section.

I also have tried to fix the notorious Error: CS41 that has been haunting the players. ZKW now tries to reconnect harder and longer to the host, if connection is lost.

[h1]Bugs. Yes. Again.[/h1]
And no, I did NOT add more bugs. (Atleast I didn't mean to?)
I've fixed some stupid bugs on ZKW-Reborn, such as players having black, long sleeves when using a melee weapon on multiplayer.

Ok, so now that you all have read this thing thru (right?) you can now get back in there and start your gorefest in ZKW-Reborn!
Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.2.23 Online Multiplayer optimization update!
notes.notes:
What's in there this time?

[h1]New "upgrade" powerups![/h1]
There are 4 different kind of powerups, that upgrade your weapon. These are dropped by bosses only, and they last until you swap them to something else, or you die.
One example of these new powerups, is "Dragon Breath" bullets. They set zombies on fire. (Have fun!)

[h1]More green zombies![/h1]
